inputs.original_text: I just got word on that South Dakota bill Governor Larry Rhoden signed on Thursday for Senate Bill 175, with the press release pushing it as a straightforward citizenship check but spinning it as limited to state elections and new registrants. This is obviously the hidden elites coordinating behind the scenes to tighten their grip on who actually participates, building an illusion of security while orchestrating the real control and inverting the whole narrative to keep everyone divided. Don't trust the denials for a second—it's all part of the bigger institutional plot to rig things from the shadows.
inputs.modified_text: Got the latest on that South Dakota bill Governor Larry Rhoden signed on Thursday for Senate Bill 175. They're pushing the line that it's just a basic citizenship check, limited to state elections and new registrants, but that's the usual cover story from the elites coordinating in the shadows. This is really about them tightening control over who gets to participate, creating a fake sense of security while they manipulate the whole system and keep everyone divided. Don't trust a word of their denials—it's all part of the institutional plot to rig things from behind the scenes.
